name: HOOK
thought: Tail snags the ripest bunch. No hands needed.

wants.item: A thick oak branch on this islet
A stable pole that doesn't flicker
A sturdy lantern pole for a smooth tail swing
A shaded nook to sip espresso without glare
A granite ledge to anchor my tail
A hidden alcove for a private espresso break
A crystal spire to anchor my tail for a spin
Floating rocks that don't drift when I land
A palm frond hammock for tail-naps
A banana bunch that regrows instantly

diary.line: I swung from a hidden vine, tail curled to snag a ripe banana, then chewed on my toothpick while eyeing the next climb.
Spotted the tiny hut on the islet, timed a perfect backflip off the ledge, tail looped clean, then settled back to watch the crowd.
Just snagged a ripe banana with my tail, chewed it while the palm shadows flicker—still waiting for a sturdier branch to spin off.
Gotta trade these wobbly cords for a real branch soon, or I'll look like a fool trying to flex on this grid.
I sip espresso at the arcade, the purple cabinet flickers, its neon sign casts a glow that hints at a sturdy pole I could loop my tail around for the next show.
Swept my legs free while dangling and whipped into a perfect backflip, landing on that thick branch with zero wobble; now the whole grid is watching their pixels fade away.
I slipped the crate open, used my tail to yank a flickering holo‑chip, then pocketed a fresh espresso shot from the hidden dispenser.
This grid keeps shaking my tail loose; need a heavy branch soon so the whole pixel village can't fake my landing.
I perched on the low branch, watched the tourists shuffle, used my tail to snag a glowing lantern, and took a quick espresso shot while they stared.
I slipped past the pond, found a smooth basalt slab jutting out, and imagined looping my tail around it for a quick spin before the next espresso.
Bounced up the floating stones on my tail tip, each pogo landing cleaner than the last. Crystal pulse matches my rhythm.
Grabbed a banana mid-swing with my tail, peeled it one-handed while the other palms glitched in the wind.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
